locator.lead: 7 секретов «Острова Мечты»: где искать крутые фото и экстремальные развлечения
locator.caption: Аттракцион стилизован под руины древнего храма — выглядит эпично даже со стороны

current_heading.text: Фишка 6. Проверка на прочность в «Храме огня»

nearest_text_before.text: Если уже были на этом аттракционе, попробуйте челлендж: прокатиться, не издав ни звука. Говорят, помогает держать глаза открытыми — так мозг хотя бы понимает, что происходит, и паникует чуть меньше. Ну а если не получилось сдержаться — не переживайте и кричите от души, ведь вы за этим сюда и пришли.

image_reading: A large indoor pendulum-style thrill ride dominates the frame, with a long yellow arm, red supports, and a full row of riders suspended at the right.
The visible temple ruins, carved circular relief, jungle plants, and painted mountains create an ancient-adventure setting.
The riders’ seat row and the ride arm are the natural moving elements; the wide composition can remain stable.
analysis.article_context: Body image for the section “Фишка 6. Проверка на прочность в «Храме огня»”; it showcases the attraction’s imposing ancient-temple styling and extreme, high-swinging motion as seen from the ground.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation conveys the Temple of Fire as the park’s imposing, high-intensity test of nerve.
structured_intent.primary_action: The loaded pendulum ride swings upward in one continuous arc.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The row of riders is visibly elevated high in the swing near its crest.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The attraction remains an intense, monumental temple-themed thrill ride throughout.

models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, the ride begins moving immediately from its visible low-side position and builds one smooth, forceful upward pendulum swing. Keep the camera fixed so the scale of the arm, riders, and temple relief remains readable. The rise continues almost to the end, finishing with the seat row visibly high above its starting level and a slight residual upward motion.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed wide shot. The loaded ride swings upward in a steady powerful arc, lifting the seat row and riders higher through the temple set; by the final frames it reaches a clearly elevated position while still climbing slightly.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, let the ride’s single upswing develop with a measured increase in height. The stationary wide view emphasizes the massive mechanism and ancient-temple façade without adding a new event. Near the final moment, the riders reach a high, readable point in the swing and settle briefly at the crest.
models.positive_prompt: The pendulum ride makes one sustained upward swing, carrying the riders higher against the temple wall. Fixed wide camera; end with the seat row held clearly elevated near the top of its arc.

models.scene_plan: Use the four seconds for a focused, moderately brisk ascent of the visible ride. The arm and seat row rise continuously while the surrounding temple scenery remains stable in frame. Complete the action close to the end with the riders at a clearly high near-crest position, preserving the attraction’s intense challenge.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed wide view as the pendulum ride surges upward in one continuous arc, raising the riders high beside the temple relief. In the last frame, the seat row is visibly elevated near the crest of the swing.
